visuals.heading: First Short Test

items.text: On 30 June 2025 a blast at a Telangana plant that makes microcrystalline cellulose, a binder used in tablets, killed workers.
A state expert committee of CSIR scientists held the management responsible for several violations.
Ask any employer about safety training, dust and fire controls, and the last inspection before you accept an offer.
Read ten live postings for each.
Make one piece of proof for each.
Ask three people who do the work.
